questions.question: What did God tell Moses and Aaron about a man's bodily discharge?
After a man was cleansed from a bodily discharge, how did the priest offer his two birds?

answers.text: A sin offering and a burnt offering
A guilt offering and a grain offering
A peace offering and a wave offering

questions.question: In God's law for Israel, how many days was a woman unclean during her menstrual period?
Why did God say the Israelites must be kept separate from their uncleanness?

answers.text: So they don't die by making His tabernacle unclean
So sickness doesn't spread from tent to tent
So the nations around them stay far away
